required_content.problem: The architecture needs a build sequence that does not introduce agency or self-improvement before auditability and governance are credible. A roadmap that jumps to autonomous improvement skips source matrices, artifact graphs, claim ledgers, tests, and authority controls.
required_content.core_mechanism: Prototype Roadmap owns a program-, roadmap-, phase-, dependency-, artifact-, acceptance-gate-, authority-, evaluator-, evidence-transition-, phase-debt-, residual-, rollback-, reviewer-, consumer-, environment-, and time-specific Evidence-Gated Phase Unlock Contract: it binds every proposed phase to prerequisites, allowed work state, required artifacts, commands, environment, resource bounds, gates, independent evaluation, residuals, debt, rollback, retirement, evidence effect, and non-claims before later work may research, demo, integrate, promote, or release; no roadmap row, milestone, source report, dashboard, task count, passing fixture, theorem, validator, build, or locally useful prototype alone establishes phase completion, safe dependency order, capability, governance effectiveness, deployment, transfer, AGI, ASI.
required_content.worked_trace: Twenty-nine exact source-to-claim mappings; one prototype phase record schema and public-safe fixture; a deterministic dependency-gate harness with two valid fixtures and six expected-invalid controls covering missing artifacts, dependency inversion, self-improvement without an independent evaluator, support promotion without an evidence transition, phase debt without retirement, and missing non-claims; three proof targets implemented by nine Lean declarations that reduce one derived negative case, hand-authored finite route functions, and fixture summaries; and one synthetic readiness/residual expired-evidence rerun/reject check.
required_content.failure_boundary: Agency-first sequencing grants tools, execution, deployment, training, or self-improvement authority before evidence, containment, rollback, and terminal governance exist. Dependency inversion lets a later phase manufacture, assume, or waive its own prerequisite or treat a cyclic dependency as progress. Roadmap-as-evidence laundering treats rows, dates, percentages, status colors, task counts, reports, demos, builds, fixtures, or proofs as completed empirical outcomes. Prototype theater presents a board, dashboard, agent loop, retrieval store, benchmark, or generated report without its acceptance packet, effects, failures, and evidence transition.
required_content.evidence_state: This chapter remains Design rationale at argument support. Its contracts, examples, tests, or local artifacts establish only their encoded scope. A finite prototype-phase route with declared prerequisites but failed acceptance gates remains research-only rather than integrating. A finite phase-promotion request without an evidence-transition record is rejected, and a reached milestone with no evidence cannot promote. A modeled prototype phase-gate fixture bridge accepts only the complete public-safe fixture summary and rejects missing non-claim boundaries while preserving no support-state promotion and no phase-completion claim.
required_content.non_claims: No chapter claim or evidence state is promoted by this visual. A named mechanism is not proof of correct implementation or useful deployment. A local check or formal model does not establish real-world enforcement. No safety, transfer, state-of-the-art, AGI, or ASI conclusion follows.
